location.address: Avenida Arias Maldonado Num 16, Edificio Skol, Bloque A, Apartamento Num 129

contentEn.title: Skol 129 – Bright Renovated Beachfront Studio with Seaside Views

contentEn.description:
free wifi

 The east-facing apartment has been fully renovated and comprises: a large lounge/bedroom with 2 single beds, a large sofa, and access to the furnished terrace, ideal for summer breakfasts; separate fully-equipped fitted kitchen, with an electric hob, microwave, coffee maker, and washing machine; and tiled bathroom with shower cabinet. 

 The apartment has its own Wi-Fi, ideal for working remotely.

 Private A/C in the bedroom and the living room. 

 Among the Skol’s facilities are its three unheated outdoors community pools, open all year round. Sunbeds have a cost of €3 per day, and are occupied on a first-come-first-served basis.

 Main reception open 24/7 to accommodate late arrivals.

 Cafeteria open seasonally, with direct access to the promenade from the community gardens.

 Bed linen and a set of towels (including beach/pool towel) per guest included in the rental price. Come and enjoy your holiday with the leader in vacation rentals in Marbella! 

 If you want a parking space, once your reservation is confirmed, you will receive information about the parking closest to the Skol Building, which you may reserve online through an external company (price and availability on their website)
